blocks.arabic_text: أَطَاعَنِي فَاتَّبَعَ مَا جِئْتُ بِهِ، وَمَثَلُ مَنْ عَصَانِي وَكَذَّبَ بِمَا جِئْتُ بِهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب الاقتداء بسنن رسول الله ﷺ رقم: ٧٢٨٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “The example of me and of the deen that Allah has sent with me is that of a man who came to his people and said, “O my people! I have seen the army (of the enemy) with my own two eyes. I am a true warner. So escape at once!” Some of that group accepted his words, slowly left during the night and escaped from the enemy. Some others considered that man's words to be a lie and stayed in their own houses until morning. When morning dawned, the enemy attacked them and tore them to pieces (destroyed them). This is the example of those who accepted my words and followed (the deen) that I have brought, and of those who disobeyed me and considered (the deen) that I have brought to be a lie.” Hazrat Abu Musa (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The Arabs had the custom of attacking at dawn; that is why it is said in the example that they travelled through the night to escape the enemy's attack.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ ﵁ قَالَ: جَاءَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ﵁ إِلَي النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! إِنِّي مَرَرْتُ بِأَخٍ لِي مِنْ قُرَيْظَةَ فَكَتَبَ لِي جَوَامِعَ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ أَلَا أَعْرِضُهَا عَلَيْكَ؟ قَالَ: فَتَغَيَّرَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللهِ يَعْنِي ابْنَ ثَابِتٍ ﵁: فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: اَلَا تَرَي مَابِوَجْهِ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ؟ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ﵁: رَضِينَا بِاللهِ تَعَالَي رَبًّا وَّبِاْلإِسْلَامِ دِيناً وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ رَسُولاً قَالَ: فَسُرِّيَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
